title: Wiking WK-PS310 PoE switch, 10x LAN/8x PoE, 1Gb, 76W

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Wiking WK-PS310 PoE Switch in Bangladesh – OTECH BD


The Wiking WK-PS310 PoE Switch is a high-performance 10-port Gigabit network switch designed for reliable power and data transmission. Featuring 8 PoE ports with a total 76W power budget, this switch is ideal for IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other PoE-enabled devices.


Built for stable and efficient networking, the WK-PS310 ensures seamless connectivity for small to medium-sized business networks, CCTV installations, and office setups.


Key Features


  • 10× LAN Ports (8× PoE Ports)
  • 1Gbps Gigabit Ethernet Speed
  • 76W Total PoE Power Budget
  • IEEE 802.3af/at PoE Support
  • Plug & Play Installation
  • Durable Metal Housing
  • Ideal for CCTV & IP Surveillance
